hero_subtitle: AI-powered soil analysis that helps every farmer understand nutrient health and grow smarter.
about_text: Soil Health Predictor helps farmers analyze soil health, detect nutrient deficiencies, and get clear fertilizer recommendations using real agronomic data and AI assistance.
features_subtitle: Everything a modern farmer needs, in one place.
feature_soil_desc: Get instant Low/Normal/High status for 12 key soil nutrients.
feature_ocr_desc: Upload your lab soil report and we auto-fill the values for you.
feature_report_desc: Full breakdown of all 12 nutrients with fertilizer type, quantity and priority.
feature_chat_desc: Ask AgriBot anything about fertilizers, soil health or irrigation, 24/7.
feature_weather_desc: Real-time temperature, humidity and rainfall for your location.
feature_score_desc: A single 0-100 score showing your soil's overall health.
how_step1_desc: Create your free farmer account in under a minute.
how_step2_desc: Type nutrient values manually or upload your soil report.
how_step3_desc: See nutrient status, health score and solutions immediately.
how_step4_desc: Follow the nutrient-wise fertilizer plan to improve your soil.
